statement: The World Bank summary says sea-level rise threatens coastlines on which much of Cabo Verde’s tourism depends.
compact_statement: The World Bank summary says sea-level rise threatens coastlines on which much of Cabo Verde’s tourism depends.
uncertainty: Summary risk only; no island-specific exposure estimate.

statement: The summary identifies drought and saline intrusion as threats to agriculture, income and food security in rural communities of this water-scarce country.
compact_statement: The summary identifies drought and saline intrusion as threats to agriculture, income and food security in rural communities of this water-scarce country.
uncertainty: Summary gives no affected-household or island breakdown.

statement: The summary identifies warming oceans and overfishing as threats to fisheries, which accounted for 72% of exports in 2021.
compact_statement: The summary identifies warming oceans and overfishing as threats to fisheries, which accounted for 72% of exports in 2021.
uncertainty: Export share is for 2021; effects are not separated.

statement: Without action, the CCDR summary projects GDP could be up to 3.6% smaller in 2050 and tourism revenue up to 10% lower.
compact_statement: Without action, the CCDR summary projects GDP could be up to 3.6% smaller in 2050 and tourism revenue up to 10% lower.
uncertainty: Headline projection; assumptions and uncertainty range omitted.

statement: The NDC reports about 0.14°C warming per decade (roughly 0.7°C over 50 years); rainfall is highly variable and has no statistically significant long-term national trend.
compact_statement: The NDC reports about 0.14°C warming per decade (roughly 0.7°C over 50 years); rainfall is highly variable and has no statistically significant long-term national trend.

source_refs.locator: Section 2.2.1, ‘Historical Climate Trends’, printed p. 11 (PDF pp. 21–22).

uncertainty: NDC summary of historical analysis; local stations show variation and should not be read as uniform island-level trends.

statement: The NDC says rural and peri-urban women in agriculture, water management and care face higher workloads and reduced income during prolonged drought and resource scarcity, while remaining underrepresented in climate governance.
compact_statement: The NDC says rural and peri-urban women in agriculture, water management and care face higher workloads and reduced income during prolonged drought and resource scarcity, while remaining underrepresented in climate governance.

source_refs.locator: Section 8.1, ‘Vulnerable Groups and Climate Impacts’, printed pp. 73–74 (PDF pp. 84–85).

uncertainty: This is the NDC’s vulnerability assessment; the cited text gives no group-level quantitative estimate.
